title: Perturbation Probing: A New Diagnostic for the Fragility of LLM Safety
content_md: New research reveals that AI safety refusal lives in a thin neural layer, highlighting the critical need for external, multi-layered security. The post Perturbation Probing: A New Diagnostic for the Fragility of LLM Safety appeared first on Unit 42 .
